title: Games: friend boxes, managing a friend, error boxes — round 4

steps.path: Gamepad button, card opened, a request each way
steps.headline: Each friend in the opened list is now its own box, like the game page's, inside the scrolling area.
steps.changed: Plain rows became boxes 8px apart (the Settings list look). The ⋯ is gone; each box has an arrow and opens that friend's details.
steps.notice: The list still scrolls under the fade, with Add a friend at the bottom.

steps.path: Gamepad button, twelve friends, card opened
steps.headline: With many friends the boxes scroll inside the card; the games stay right below it.
steps.changed: Same boxes on the long practice list.
steps.notice: About four boxes show before it scrolls.

steps.headline: Incognito: the line under your name says how many friends you have and that who's online is hidden.
steps.changed: You asked for the online count here. While you're incognito the app is disconnected from friends on purpose, so it cannot know who is online; the line says so instead of showing a guessed number.

steps.headline: The red error box loses its red title: one plain sentence and Try again, like most of the app's error boxes.
steps.changed: 13 of the app's 16 red notice boxes have no title; the 3 that use red title text are listed in the round report for a later decision.
steps.notice: Text reads "Can't reach the game server. Your friends, Connect 4 and Chess are unavailable…".

steps.headline: The amber no-internet box matches: one sentence starting "No internet connection." and Try again.
steps.changed: Its separate title line is gone, so both error boxes have the same shape.
steps.notice: Shown only when the computer reports no network.

steps.path: Games → open the friends card → a friend
steps.headline: How should you see a friend's @handle and unfriend or block them, now the ⋯ menu is gone?
steps.notice: Every version asks before blocking, with the same warning; unfriending is one press, as before.

variants.label: Friend details popup
variants.summary: Click a friend's box: a small popup like Session details shows their name, status and @handle, with Unfriend and Block… under it.

variants.label: Manage opens the box
variants.summary: A Manage button on each box opens it in place (like editing a tag in Session details) to show the @handle, Unfriend and Block…; Done closes it.
variants.risk: A Manage button on every row adds a lot of buttons.

variants.label: Edit mode for the list
variants.summary: "Edit friends" beside Add a friend switches the whole list (like Account's Edit account): every box shows its @handle with Unfriend and Block…; Done ends it.
variants.risk: Two steps to reach one friend's actions.
